facts.fact: Le Mauricien reports Mauritius's Cybercrime Unit handled 930 cases from January 2023 to January 2026, leading to 130 arrests, with 7 cases referred to court and no conviction yet.

Le Mauricien reports the Cybercrime Unit's count of 930 cases handled between January 2023 and January 2026, with their outcomes (177 closed, 660 under investigation, 33 awaiting DPP advice, 7 before court).
